title: Kung Pao Chicken Wings
description: A spicy and savory twist on traditional Chinese street food, featuring crispy fried chicken wings in a savory sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, cornstarch, and red pepper flakes.
Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat.
Let the wings marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the peanut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the wings to the skillet and cook until crispy and golden brown, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the wings from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the ginger and garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the scallions to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 1 minute.
Return the wings to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
